name: Browser click
description: Clicks an element (by CSS selector or accessibility role/name) or a point (by x/y coordinates) in the visible in-app browser the user is watching.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 在用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器中，按 CSS 选择器或角色快照的 role/name 点击元素，或按 x/y 视口坐标点击某点，操作对用户实时可见。
localizedDescription.en-US: Clicks an element (by CSS selector or accessibility role/name) or a point (by x/y coordinates) in the visible in-app browser the user is watching.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click (first match).

role.description: Accessibility role from a format=roles snapshot (used when selector is omitted). Must match exactly one element.

name.description: Accessible name from a format=roles snapshot. Optional with role; unique match still required.

x.description: Viewport X coordinate to click (used when selector is omitted).

y.description: Viewport Y coordinate to click (used when selector is omitted).
